name: @hunch-vpm/subgraph-erc8004-arc
description: Agent0's standardized ERC-8004 subgraph schema, retargeted at Arc's identity, reputation and validation registries

scripts.build:arc: graph codegen && node tools/with-network.mjs arc build
scripts.//: test runs both suites because `pnpm -r --if-present test` invokes test and nothing else: leaving matchstick out would hide every mapping handler from CI. codegen comes first because generated/ is not committed, and `graph test` fetches a platform-specific matchstick binary on first run, so a cold job needs network here.
scripts.test: graph codegen && vitest run && graph test
scripts.deploy:arc-testnet: node tools/with-network.mjs arc-testnet deploy erc-8004-arc-testnet --node https://api.studio.thegraph.com/deploy/
scripts.deploy:arc: node tools/with-network.mjs arc deploy erc8004-arc --node https://api.studio.thegraph.com/deploy/
